title: CP2K：SCF 收縮、停止原因與假收斂診斷
titleEn: CP2K: SCF contraction, stopping reasons and false-convergence diagnosis
subcategoryTitle: 分子、電子結構與粒子科學計算
summary: 使用原創合成資料研究「CP2K：SCF 收縮、停止原因與假收斂診斷」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付殘差歷程、停止原因表、能量與缺陷對照以及續算決策紀錄。
summaryEn: Investigate CP2K: SCF contraction, stopping reasons and false-convergence diagnosis using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver residual histories, stopping-reason tables, energy-versus-defect comparisons and a restart decision explaining which downstream quantities remain unqualified when electronic convergence fails.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

quiz.question: 「定義缺陷與計數」：哪一項是需要由具名官方來源查證的案例背景，而非本課的故障假說或處置判斷？
quiz.questionEn: Define defect and iteration numbering: Which is case context to establish from the named official source, rather than a fault hypothesis or disposition?
options: 能量變化很小但缺陷停滯可能是假收斂；振盪可能來自混合或初始狀態，迭代上限停止不可改標為成功。
僅基線通過本課門檻；較慢收縮組需修改策略並重新驗證，不得直接放寬門檻來保留原本的科學結論。
電子結構計算的 SCF 迴圈結束可能是收斂，也可能只是達到迭代上限；用殘差歷程區分並安排後續計算。
optionsEn: Small energy changes alongside a stalled defect can indicate false convergence. Oscillation may involve mixing or the initial state; reaching an iteration limit must never be relabeled as successful convergence.

Only the baseline passes this fixture’s threshold. The slower contraction case needs a revised strategy and renewed validation; relaxing a tolerance requires reconsidering the scientific claim rather than merely changing the status label.

An electronic-structure SCF loop can stop because it converged or because its iteration budget expired. Use a residual history to distinguish the outcomes before trusting downstream forces or energies.

steps.check: 七列資料但只有六次更新；不可把初值誤算成已完成迭代。
steps.checkEn: There are seven rows but six updates; the initial value is not a completed iteration.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: 電子結構計算的 SCF 迴圈結束可能是收斂，也可能只是達到迭代上限；用殘差歷程區分並安排後續計算。
knowledge.textEn: An electronic-structure SCF loop can stop because it converged or because its iteration budget expired. Use a residual history to distinguish the outcomes before trusting downstream forces or energies.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 使用原創合成資料研究「CP2K：SCF 收縮、停止原因與假收斂診斷」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付殘差歷程、停止原因表、能量與缺陷對照以及續算決策紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Investigate CP2K: SCF contraction, stopping reasons and false-convergence diagnosis using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver residual histories, stopping-reason tables, energy-versus-defect comparisons and a restart decision explaining which downstream quantities remain unqualified when electronic convergence fails.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學缺陷量 e_k=e0 q^k 描述固定線性收縮；它不是 CP2K 的通用能量誤差公式，真實 EPS_SCF 意義須依求解設定。
knowledge.textEn: The instructional defect model e_k=e0*q^k assumes constant linear contraction. It is not a universal CP2K energy-error formula, and the actual meaning of an SCF threshold depends on the selected solver and diagnostic.

stages.title: 定義缺陷與計數
stages.description: 建立 k=0 至 6 的欄位，將初值與六次更新分開；標示此缺陷是教學代理量而非直接引用 CP2K 所有模式。
stages.descriptionEn: Create rows k=0 through k=6, separating the initial defect from six completed updates. Label the quantity as a teaching proxy and identify the actual SCF diagnostic that would need inspection in a chosen CP2K configuration.
